title: Rinnai’s new heat pump water heaters get smarter – and easier to install
summary: Rinnai has launched a new lineup of electric heat pump water heaters that adds wifi controls and more installation options to an appliance that can cut the energy needed for hot showers. more…

title: Tesla Cybercab orders open at $29,990 + $299/mo, only in Robotaxi zones
summary: Tesla is now inviting “select customers” to buy a Cybercab for personal use at $29,990, but the car won’t move unless you also pay $299 a month for an “Autonomy Subscription.” And it only works inside Tesla’s Robotaxi service areas in Texas and Florida, the same geofences that have turned out to be significantly smaller than what Tesla advertises. more…

title: $20K Nissan NX7 PHEV goes on sale with nearly 200 miles of electric range
summary: Dongfeng Nissan officially opened the early order book on its new NX7 hybrid yesterday, promising up to 320 km (~198 miles) of all-electric range from a 40 kWh lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery and a $20,000 price tag. more…

title: Check your ego at the door: Stellantis’ new electric dolly turns ANY car into a tow rig
summary: We all know the type: grizzled stubble, wraparound PitVipers, a MAGA hat quietly retired after last week’s deep-blue shellacking , and a pristine, polished pickup parked in the driveway that they “need for towing.” With Stellantis’ new patent for an AI-powered electric tow dolly that turns just about ANY vehicle into a capable tow rig, however, those might need a new to find a new excuse to keep that gas-guzzler. more…

title: Huawei set to challenge Tesla Powerwall with new, 20 kW home battery
summary: This high-tech Huawei home battery pack hopes to hold back Tesla’s latest Powerwall with silicon carbide technology, AI-powered energy management baked in , and enough modular storage to keep even large homes bright and warm when the rest of the block goes dark. more…

title: I finally got a USB-C charging e-bike, and it costs 75% less than Rivian’s bike
summary: I’ve been waiting years for electric bikes to finally embrace USB-C charging. We’ve already standardized much of our lives around the convenient little connector, from phones and laptops to tablets and countless other gadgets. But for some reason, electric bikes have largely missed the memo. Now, though, I’m finally riding an e-bike that charges with USB-C, and the best part is that it doesn’t cost an arm and a leg. more…

title: Tesla Cybercab’s autonomy agreement is insane: $299/mo or it doesn’t move
summary: Tesla has posted the agreement that comes with its $29,990 Cybercab, and it’s even worse than the order page suggested. The two-seater can’t move without a $299 monthly “Autonomy Subscription” that Tesla can reprice with a month’s notice, suspend for a week, or cut off entirely. And Tesla wants consumers to sign it while still refusing to give unsupervised self-driving to the Model Y owners it has been selling “Full Self-Driving” to for nearly a decade. more…
